tier_1.independence: The verifier does not import the producer. It constructs the spin-two matrices independently, checks the su(2) commutator and Casimir, replays the polynomial ball witness, checks all input hashes and rejects false real-radical/orbit promotions.

repair_history.finding: The initial square-root witness used S and r without declaring the branch predicate r<=2S, so symbolic conjugation did not reduce sqrt(S-r/2)^2.
The witness was replaced by polynomial coordinates S=x^2+y^2 and r=2y^2. This exposes the exact domain 0<=r<=2S and removes the branch-sensitive simplification.

tier_2.criterion: No upstream mathematical input, shared operator or shared schema changed; all six imported certificates are pinned by exact SHA-256.

tier_3.criterion: The active real radical and full orbit quotient remain OPEN; no theorem-freeze, tag or release was promoted.

claim_boundary: This receipt certifies exact spectator elimination to connected spin-two moment-ball fibres and the resulting 40-real active gate. It is not a pass for the active real radical, orbit quotient, global finite-support cone, causality or all-orders integration.
